links.outcome: Segmentation accuracy variation across voxel size, orientation, and osteosynthesis or pathology
links.effect: Segmentation accuracy varied by up to 25% depending on voxel size, bone orientation, and patient conditions such as osteosynthesis or pathology; metallic osteosynthesis and anatomical complexity significantly degraded results.
links.quote: We show that segmentation accuracy varies by up to 25% depending on socio-technical factors such as voxel size, bone orientation, and patient conditions such as osteosynthesis or pathology.

screen.reason: Multicenter evaluation evaluating robustness and error modes (socio-technical/imaging factors) of 20 mandibular segmentation models across 1,000 CT/CBCT scans without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
